title: Long-time dynamics toward a generic composite wave for the inflow problem of the Navier--Stokes--Fourier system
summary: We study the time-asymptotic stability of solutions to the inflow problem for the one-dimensional Navier--Stokes--Fourier system on the half-line. We consider the most generic wave pattern: the superposition of a degenerate boundary layer, a rarefaction, a viscous contact wave, and a viscous shock.
